text: The Rust team is happy to announce Rust 1.92. This release stabilizes async closures in trait objects, adds the `Vec::extract_if` method and speeds up incremental builds by about 12 percent.
title: Announcing Rust 1.92

text: The Rust team is happy to announce Rust 1.92. This release stabilizes async closures in trait objects, adds the `Vec::extract_if` method and speeds up incremental builds by about 12 percent. Upgrade with rustup update stable.
title: Rust 1.92 is out: async closures in trait objects

text: The Rust team has published Rust 1.93. Highlights include stable inline const patterns, a new `#[diagnostic::on_move]` attribute and support for the aarch64 Windows target as tier 1.

text: A heap overflow in libquill's PNG decoder (CVE-2026-31337) allows remote code execution via crafted images. Version 2.4.1 fixes the issue; distributions are shipping updates.
title: CVE-2026-31337: heap overflow in libquill, patch available

text: Attackers are actively exploiting CVE-2026-31337 in libquill through malicious avatars on chat platforms. CISA added the flaw to its catalog and set a two-week patch deadline.
title: libquill CVE-2026-31337 now exploited in the wild
